name: tierlist-video-maker
description: Turn a published TierVibe tier list into a narrated video. Fetches the tier list + card images, captures a high-resolution board image from the public page (Playwright, no server call), identifies cards via AI vision, generates a reviewable narration script, TTS, subtitles, and a scrolling-background video.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a published TierVibe tier list into a narrated video.
interface.longDescription: Fetches the tier list and card images, captures a high-resolution board image from the public page via Playwright (the whole-image export is a user-side action, automated — no TierVibe server call), identifies each card with AI vision, drafts a narration script for user review, generates TTS audio + SRT subtitles, and composes a video with a scrolling tier-list background and per-card zoom overlays.
defaultPrompt: Make a video from this TierVibe tier list
把这个 TierVibe 做成视频
Narrate this tier list into a video
